basic_profile.bio: TechSage42 is a tech enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. They have a deep interest in virtual reality and have been using Oculus products since their launch. When not immersed in VR, they enjoy live music and are frequently involved in local punk rock scenes. They work as a freelance software developer, which gives them the flexibility to explore their tech hobbies and attend concerts. Often online during late evenings, TechSage42 is currently single and enjoys the freedom to explore various subcultures both online and offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: TechSage42 has a solid background in computer science, having earned a degree from a state university. Their expertise in VR technology stems from both formal education and years of self-teaching, staying updated through online courses and tech forums. They are particularly knowledgeable about the integration of social media with VR platforms.
